jobs.description:
At Raiffeisen Bank International, we are pleased to have more than 17 million customers in Austria and 12 other CEE countries - what got us here, are our talented people. 2 Student Job (f/m/x) - Full Stack Development (20 h/week) 

Are you passionate about software development and excited to see your code used in a real business environment? Join our ESG Capital Market Solutions team at RBI, a young and dynamic team within Raiffeisen Research focused on data-driven solutions and digital innovation. Help us build self-developed AI applications and interactive web solutions that bring our research to life.

 

 

At a glance:

 

 * Start: immediately

 * Working hours: 20 hours/week (within office hours Mon-Thu 8am - 5pm, Fri 8am - 2pm) 

 * Location: RBI Vienna

 

Your role in our team:

 

 * Develop and maintain modern front-end applications, mainly with Svelte, and support back-end and database development using Python and SQL

 * Help build self-developed AI tools, including chatbot solutions and other smart applications for internal and clients use

 * Work closely with the team on digital products that connect technology, data, and market insights in a practical way

 

 

You are right for us if...

 

 * You are studying computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related quantitative field and have practical experience with Python

 * You have professional proficiency in English

 * You are curious, proactive, and enjoy working in a team where you can learn quickly and contribute with your own ideas

 *  You want to gain hands-on experience with modern web development and AI applications in an international banking environment

 

 

Nice to have:

 

 * Additional knowledge in other programming languages such as R, JavaScript, or frameworks like Svelte is advantageous

 * Hands-on experience with database structures and SQL

 * Experience with collaborative development processes and tools like Git

 * German language is a plus

 

 

What we offer you:

 

 * Work & Study: gain experience in the international banking environment & boost the balance of your bank account 

 * Flexibility: adapt your working hours to your university schedule 

 * Onboarding: enjoy an easy start - a buddy from your team will take you along 

 * Community: network internally with other students 

 * Canteen: healthy, tasty, and heavily subsidized 

 * Corporate Benefits: shopping vouchers from the staffs' council (eg. supermarkets), free museum tickets, attractive sports offers, reduced fitness center membership, reduced price public transport pass etc. 

 * Compensation: we pay an attractive monthly student salary of gross EUR 2,619.73 (on a basis of 38.5 hours)  

 

Apply now!
